info.title: Alazab Daftra finance
info.description: Derived from supplied API export; tenant and runtime validation required.

get.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. List incomes, most recent first.

Returns a paginated array under `data[]`, each entry wrapped in an `Income` object, plus a `pagination` summary. Only income records are returned (expense records are served by the separate expenses endpoints).

Results can be narrowed with the query filters below and ordered with `sort`/`direction`. Some filters depend on the account's configuration or enabled plugins, as noted per parameter.

**Access:** available to the account owner, or to staff holding any of the *View His Own Incomes*, *Add New Incomes*, or *Edit/Delete His Own Incomes* permissions. Staff without *View All Incomes* or *Edit/Delete All Incomes* see only incomes they recorded.

parameters.description: Number of items per page (1–1000). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: page

post.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Create an income.

The request body wraps the income fields in an `Income` object. Optionally include a `JournalTransaction` array to split the amount across chart-of-accounts accounts, a `CostCenterTransaction` array for cost-center allocation, and a `RecurringExpense` object to set up recurrence.

Only `amount` and `date` are required. Most other fields are optional and are defaulted automatically when omitted (see each field). Server-managed fields such as the record type, the recording staff member, and the status are set automatically and cannot be assigned from the request.

**Idempotency:** pass a unique `unique_id` to safely retry. If a previous request with the same `unique_id` already created an income, the response echoes that income (`result` = `duplicated`) instead of creating a duplicate.

**Access:** requires the account owner, or staff holding the *Add New Incomes* (or *Draft*) permission.

amount.description: **Required.** Income amount. Must be non-zero. Treated as gross of any taxes supplied.

date.description: **Required.** Income date, in the account's date format (e.g. `YYYY-MM-DD`). Must fall within an open financial period.

currency_code.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to the account currency when omitted.

category.description: Category name. Created automatically if it does not exist. Alternatively pass `expense_category_id`.

supplier_id.description: Linked supplier reference. A suspended supplier is rejected.

treasury_id.description: Treasury to deposit into. Defaults to the primary treasury when omitted.

journal_account_id.description: Journal (chart-of-accounts) account. Optional unless the account is configured to make account selection mandatory and no account is supplied via `JournalTransaction`.

unit_id.description: Rental-unit reference; sets the income source to that unit.

expense_number.description: Income number / reference code. Generated automatically when omitted.

attachment.description: Comma-separated list of previously uploaded file ids to attach. Must be a string; an array is rejected with 400.

unique_id.description: Client-supplied idempotency key. Reusing a key returns the original income instead of creating a duplicate.

tax1_id.description: First tax reference. When omitted, all first-tax fields are cleared.

tax1_value.description: First tax rate (percentage). The tax amount is computed automatically.

tax1_included.description:
Whether the first tax is included in `amount`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Added on top |
| 1 | Included |

tax2_id.description: Second tax reference. When omitted, all second-tax fields are cleared.

tax2_value.description: Second tax rate (percentage). The tax amount is computed automatically.

tax2_included.description:
Whether the second tax is included in `amount`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Added on top |
| 1 | Included |

clone_id.description: Reference of an existing income to record this one as a clone of (for audit linkage).

JournalTransaction.description: Optional. Splits the income across chart-of-accounts accounts. Entries with an empty `amount` are ignored, and the sum of the remaining amounts must equal `Income.amount`.

amount.description: Portion of the income allocated to this account.

journal_account_id.description: Target account. Alternatively identify the account by `entity_type` + `entity_id`.

entity_type.description: Resolve the account automatically from a related entity (used instead of `journal_account_id`).

entity_id.description: Reference of the entity named by `entity_type`.

included.description: Whether the line tax is included in the line amount (0/1).

CostCenterTransaction.description: Optional. Cost-center allocations for the income. Each entry allocates part of the amount to a cost center.

amount.description: Amount allocated to this cost center.

RecurringExpense.description: Optional. Recurrence settings to repeat this income on a schedule.

202.description: The income was created. When an idempotency `unique_id` matches a previous request, `result` is `duplicated` and the fields identify the already-existing income.

result.description: `successful` for a new income, `duplicated` when an idempotent retry matched an existing one.

id.description: Reference of the created (or existing) income.

400.description: Validation failed (e.g. missing `amount`/`date`, zero amount, date in a closed period, or a non-string `attachment`).

validation_errors.description: Map of field name to error message.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks permission to add incomes.

500.description: The request body was not valid JSON or the content type was not accepted.

put.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Update an existing income.

This is a partial update — send only the `Income` fields you want to change. Any field validated on create keeps its rule when supplied (e.g. a supplied `amount` must be non-zero, a supplied `date` must fall in an open period). The income id is taken from the path; any `id` in the body is ignored.

Optionally include `JournalTransaction` / `CostCenterTransaction` arrays to replace the account and cost-center allocation, or a `RecurringExpense` object.

The same operation is also reachable via `POST /incomes/{id}`.

An income that is locked to another record (e.g. generated from another entity) or already used in an income-distribution transaction cannot be edited.

**Access:** requires the account owner, or staff with *Edit/Delete All Incomes*, or *Edit/Delete His Own Incomes* (for their own records), or *Draft* (for their own draft records).

Income.description: The income fields to change. Provide only the fields you want to update.

amount.description: Income amount. Must be non-zero when supplied.

date.description: Income date, in the account's date format. Must fall within an open financial period when supplied.

category.description: Category name. Created automatically if it does not exist. Alternatively pass `expense_category_id`.

unit_id.description: Rental-unit reference; sets the income source to that unit.

attachment.description: Comma-separated list of previously uploaded file ids. Must be a string; an array is rejected with 400.

tax1_id.description: First tax reference. When omitted, all first-tax fields are cleared.

tax1_value.description: First tax rate (percentage). The tax amount is computed automatically.

tax1_included.description: Whether the first tax is included in `amount` (0/1).

tax2_id.description: Second tax reference. When omitted, all second-tax fields are cleared.

tax2_value.description: Second tax rate (percentage). The tax amount is computed automatically.

tax2_included.description: Whether the second tax is included in `amount` (0/1).

JournalTransaction.description: Optional. Replaces the chart-of-accounts allocation. Entries with an empty `amount` are ignored, and the sum of the remaining amounts must equal `Income.amount`.

amount.description: Portion of the income allocated to this account.

journal_account_id.description: Target account. Alternatively identify it by `entity_type` + `entity_id`.

entity_type.description: Resolve the account automatically from a related entity.

entity_id.description: Reference of the entity named by `entity_type`.

included.description: Whether the line tax is included in the line amount (0/1).

CostCenterTransaction.description: Optional. Replaces the cost-center allocation for the income.

amount.description: Amount allocated to this cost center.

400.description: Validation failed (e.g. zero amount, date in a closed period, or a non-string `attachment`).

validation_errors.description: Map of field name to error message.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks permission to edit this income, or a mobile request tried to edit a record last updated from the web.

404.description: No income with the given id exists.

delete.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Delete an income by id.

Deleting an income also removes its related accounting journal and attachments.

An income cannot be deleted while it is linked to another record (e.g. generated from another entity), already used in an income-distribution transaction, or dated in a closed financial period.

**Access:** requires the account owner, or staff with *Edit/Delete All Incomes* or *Edit/Delete His Own Incomes* (for their own records).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Reference of the income to delete.

400.description: The request is invalid — the id is missing, or the income cannot be deleted because it is linked to another record or has related transactions.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks permission to delete this income.

404.description: No income with the given id exists (or it is outside the caller's access scope).

500.description: The income could not be deleted due to a server-side error.

get.description: Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a paginated list of treasuries and bank accounts. The result is limited to the treasuries the authenticated user is allowed to view: a staff member sees only treasuries they hold a withdraw or deposit permission on, while an account owner or admin sees all. Requires a treasury permission or the *General Settings* permission. Each item includes a computed `balance`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items per page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve.

staff_id.description: Owner staff id, or `0` for the account owner.

name.description: Name of the treasury or bank account.

type.description:
Kind of account.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Bank account |
| 2 | Personal (legacy) |
| 3 | Treasury (cash) |

type_account_number.description: Bank account number (used for bank accounts).

active.description:
Whether the treasury is active.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Inactive |
| 1 | Active |

is_primary.description:
Whether this is the primary (default) treasury.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Not primary |
| 1 | Primary |

currency_code.description: ISO currency code (set for bank accounts; treasuries default to the account currency).

balance.description: Current balance of the treasury, computed at read time.

modified.description: Time the treasury was last updated.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid access token.

403.description: Forbidden — the user has no treasury permission and lacks the General Settings permission.

post.description: MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Creates a treasury (cash account) or bank account. The request body is wrapped in a `Treasury` object. Only `name` is required; `type` defaults to Treasury and `active` defaults to inactive when omitted. Setting `is_primary` to `1` makes this the default treasury (and activates it). Requires the *General Settings* or *Manage Journal Accounts* permission.

name.description: Name of the treasury or bank account. Required.

type.description:
Kind of account. Optional; defaults to `3` (Treasury).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Bank account |
| 2 | Personal (legacy) |
| 3 | Treasury (cash) |

is_primary.description:
Whether this is the primary (default) treasury. Optional; defaults to `0`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Not primary |
| 1 | Primary |

Setting `1` also activates this treasury and clears the primary flag on all others.

active.description:
Whether the treasury is active. Optional; defaults to `0` (Inactive) when omitted.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Inactive |
| 1 | Active |

type_name.description: Bank/account label. Optional; used for bank accounts.

type_account_number.description: Bank account number. Optional; used for bank accounts.

currency_code.description: ISO currency code. Optional; used for bank accounts. Treasuries use the account currency.

id.description: Identifier of the newly created treasury.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid access token.

402.description: Payment Required — the plan's treasury/bank limit has been reached. This response uses a distinct envelope and does not include the `result` field.

403.description: Forbidden — the user lacks the General Settings / Manage Journal Accounts permission.

get.description: Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a single treasury or bank account by id. Requires one of the treasury-related permissions (assigned-treasury view, change default treasury, view all journals, manage journal accounts) or the *General Settings* permission; staff additionally must hold a withdraw or deposit permission on the requested treasury.

parameters.description: Identifier of the treasury to retrieve.

staff_id.description: Owner staff id, or `0` for the account owner.

name.description: Name of the treasury or bank account.

type.description:

|---|---|
| 1 | Bank account |

is_primary.description:
Whether this is the primary (default) treasury.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Not primary |
| 1 | Primary |

currency_code.description: ISO currency code (set for bank accounts; treasuries default to the account currency).

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid access token.

403.description: Forbidden — the user lacks a treasury-related permission and General Settings.

404.description: Not found — no treasury with this id is accessible to the user.

put.description: MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Updates an existing treasury or bank account by id. The request body is wrapped in a `Treasury` object; the id is taken from the path. Setting `active` to `0` also clears the primary flag, and a bank account's `currency_code` cannot be changed once it has transactions. Requires one of the treasury-related permissions or the *General Settings* / *Manage Journal Accounts* permission. (A `POST /treasuries/{id}` request is accepted as an alias for this update.)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the treasury to update.

name.description: Name of the treasury or bank account.

type.description:
Kind of account.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Bank account |
| 2 | Personal (legacy) |
| 3 | Treasury (cash) |

is_primary.description:
Whether this is the primary (default) treasury.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Not primary |
| 1 | Primary |

Setting `1` also activates this treasury and clears the primary flag on all others.

active.description:
Whether the treasury is active. Setting `0` also clears the primary flag.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Inactive |
| 1 | Active |

currency_code.description: ISO currency code (bank accounts). Cannot be changed once the bank has transactions.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid access token.

402.description: Payment Required — returned only when activating a previously-inactive treasury and the plan's treasury/bank limit has been reached. This response uses a distinct envelope and does not include the `result` field.

403.description: Forbidden — the user lacks a treasury-related permission and General Settings / Manage Journal Accounts.

404.description: Not found — no treasury with this id is accessible to the user.

delete.description: MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Deletes a treasury or bank account by id. Deletion is only allowed when the treasury is not in use: it must not be the primary treasury and must have no loans, pay-run / sales / purchase payments, bank or journal transactions, treasury transfers, cheque books, or staff using it as their default. A treasury that is in use can be deactivated instead. Requires one of the treasury-related permissions or the *General Settings* / *Manage Journal Accounts* permission.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the treasury to delete.

message.description: Confirmation message, e.g. `<name> has been deleted`.

400.description: Bad Request — the treasury is in use and cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.

message.description:
Reason the treasury cannot be deleted. It can be deactivated instead. Possible values:

| Message |
|---|
| You can't delete primary treasury |
| This treasury has loan, you can make it inactive |
| This treasury has pay run payments, you can make it inactive |
| This treasury has sales payments, you can make it inactive |
| This treasury has purchase payments, you can make it inactive |
| This treasury has existing transactions, you can make it inactive |
| This bank has existing transactions, you can make it inactive. |

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid access token.

403.description: Forbidden — the user lacks a treasury-related permission and General Settings / Manage Journal Accounts.

404.description: Not found — no treasury with this id is accessible to the user.

post.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Create an expense.

The request body wraps the expense fields in an `Expense` object. Optionally include a `JournalTransaction` array to split the amount across chart-of-accounts accounts, a `CostCenterTransaction` array for cost-center allocation, and a `RecurringExpense` object to set up recurrence.

Only `amount` and `date` are required. Most other fields are optional and are defaulted automatically when omitted (see each field). Server-managed fields such as the record type, the recording staff member, and the status are set automatically and cannot be assigned from the request.

**Idempotency:** pass a unique `unique_id` to safely retry. If a previous request with the same `unique_id` already created an expense, the response echoes that expense (`result` = `duplicated`) instead of creating a duplicate.

**Access:** requires the account owner, or staff holding the *Add New Expenses* (or *Draft*) permission.

amount.description: **Required.** Expense amount. Must be non-zero. Treated as gross of any taxes supplied.

date.description: **Required.** Expense date, in the account's date format (e.g. `YYYY-MM-DD`). Must fall within an open financial period.

currency_code.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to the account currency when omitted.

category.description: Category name. Created automatically if it does not exist. Alternatively pass `expense_category_id`.

supplier_id.description: Linked supplier reference. A suspended supplier is rejected.

treasury_id.description: Treasury to withdraw from. Defaults to the primary treasury when omitted.

journal_account_id.description: Journal (chart-of-accounts) account. Optional unless the account is configured to make account selection mandatory and no account is supplied via `JournalTransaction`.

unit_id.description: Rental-unit reference; sets the expense source to that unit.

expense_number.description: Expense number / reference code. Generated automatically when omitted.

attachment.description: Comma-separated list of previously uploaded file ids to attach. Must be a string; an array is rejected with 400.

unique_id.description: Client-supplied idempotency key. Reusing a key returns the original expense instead of creating a duplicate.

tax1_id.description: First tax reference. When omitted, all first-tax fields are cleared.

tax1_value.description: First tax rate (percentage). The tax amount is computed automatically.

tax1_included.description:
Whether the first tax is included in `amount`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Added on top |
| 1 | Included |

tax2_id.description: Second tax reference. When omitted, all second-tax fields are cleared.

tax2_value.description: Second tax rate (percentage). The tax amount is computed automatically.

tax2_included.description:
Whether the second tax is included in `amount`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Added on top |
| 1 | Included |

clone_id.description: Reference of an existing expense to record this one as a clone of (for audit linkage).

JournalTransaction.description: Optional. Splits the expense across chart-of-accounts accounts. Entries with an empty `amount` are ignored, and the sum of the remaining amounts must equal `Expense.amount`.

amount.description: Portion of the expense allocated to this account.

journal_account_id.description: Target account. Alternatively identify the account by `entity_type` + `entity_id`.

entity_type.description: Resolve the account automatically from a related entity (used instead of `journal_account_id`).

entity_id.description: Reference of the entity named by `entity_type`.

included.description: Whether the line tax is included in the line amount (0/1).

CostCenterTransaction.description: Optional. Cost-center allocations for the expense. Each entry allocates part of the amount to a cost center.

amount.description: Amount allocated to this cost center.

RecurringExpense.description: Optional. Recurrence settings to repeat this expense on a schedule.

202.description: The expense was created. When an idempotency `unique_id` matches a previous request, `result` is `duplicated` and the fields identify the already-existing expense.

result.description: `successful` for a new expense, `duplicated` when an idempotent retry matched an existing one.

id.description: Reference of the created (or existing) expense.

400.description: Validation failed (e.g. missing `amount`/`date`, zero amount, date in a closed period, or a non-string `attachment`).

validation_errors.description: Map of field name to error message.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks permission to add expenses.

500.description: The request body was not valid JSON or the content type was not accepted.

Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Retrieve a single expense by id.

Returns the expense wrapped in an `Expense` object under `data`.

**Access:** available to the account owner, or to staff holding any of the *View His Own Expenses*, *Add New Expenses*, or *Edit/Delete His Own Expenses* permissions. Staff without *View All Expenses* or *Edit/Delete All Expenses* can only read expenses they recorded.

put.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Update an existing expense.

This is a partial update — send only the `Expense` fields you want to change. Any field validated on create keeps its rule when supplied (e.g. a supplied `amount` must be non-zero, a supplied `date` must fall in an open period). The expense id is taken from the path; any `id` in the body is ignored.

Optionally include `JournalTransaction` / `CostCenterTransaction` arrays to replace the account and cost-center allocation, or a `RecurringExpense` object.

The same operation is also reachable via `POST /expenses/{id}`.

An expense that is locked to another record (e.g. generated from another entity) or already used in an expense-distribution transaction cannot be edited.

**Access:** requires the account owner, or staff with *Edit/Delete All Expenses*, or *Edit/Delete His Own Expenses* (for their own records), or *Draft* (for their own draft records).

delete.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Delete an expense by id.

Deleting an expense also removes its related accounting journal and attachments.

An expense cannot be deleted while it is linked to another record (e.g. generated from another entity), already used in an expense-distribution transaction, or dated in a closed financial period.

**Access:** requires the account owner, or staff with *Edit/Delete All Expenses* or *Edit/Delete His Own Expenses* (for their own records).
